units.frame_of_reference: feet measured above current support, map coordinates [east,north,elevation]

common.on_site_control: All heroes may traverse ordinary dry approaches and use posture-valid pockets. Kindle on eligible ground inside the 3 m site disk. Quench on eligible ground within 1.5 m of the actual placed vessel, including just outside that disk, with a valid reach path.

gandiva_line.name: Gandiva Line
gandiva_line.limit: Single contact per shot, one visible target, spent on release.

vayu_flight.name: Maruti Ribbon
vayu_flight.limit: One thrust window. Full 12 m is an upper bound; land to rearm after cooldown. Foot elevation is relative to the supported launch.

crescent_advance.name: Crescent Advance
crescent_advance.limit: Horizontal lunge stops on hard cover. The extra arms animate a single hit volume.

sudarshana_return.name: Sudarshana Return
sudarshana_return.limit: Single contact per target across both legs, at most one contact per target per cast. Return aims at the recorded release anchor.

lion_ward.name: Lion Ward
lion_ward.limit: 2.6 m radius on a visible supported floor. A single 28 HP grant per ally per cast, max shield applies.

sun_lance.name: Sun Lance
sun_lance.limit: One bolt; a 0.2 s gold glint and narrow ray show the selected lane before release.

loaded_choice.name: Loaded Choice
loaded_choice.limit: Commit the smoke face before casting. One two-sided screen, width 2.8 m. Game-state receipts come only from the ritual host.

lanka_wall.name: Lanka Wall
lanka_wall.limit: Single visible wall 3 m wide. Preview checks the objective apron and every entrance. Both sides use the same solid.

night_vault.name: Night Vault
night_vault.limit: One grounded takeoff. Prevalidate full capsule and supported landing. Remove the destination on interrupt.

ember_thread.name: Ember Thread
ember_thread.limit: One visible ally, max 20 HP in two pulses. Range, height or hard cover breaks the second pulse.

kodanda.name: Kodanda
kodanda.limit: Rust battle: radius .22 m, 28 HP, first contacted enemy or hard cover. Accepted primary consumes a quiver arrow.

stillwater_coil.name: Stillwater Coil
stillwater_coil.limit: Shiva motion-script radius/range/lifetime/cooldown; proposed 1.5 m band and tell belong to the vertical study. Slow never extends the ritual clock.

heroes.aim_and_follow: Draw at the exposed lip, release along the surveyed line, then shift before a second shot.
heroes.counter: Hard cover breaks acquisition; a silhouette behind two opposing mouths offers two separate choices.

heroes.aim_and_follow: Read the overhead turn, burst past a contested sightline, settle on measured support, then fan or call Sena.
heroes.counter: Ceilings stop ascent; the predicted return and persistent foot-shadow give the other team time to hold the landing.

heroes.aim_and_follow: Show an ash edge from cover, cross the door, then sweep at a grounded target.
heroes.counter: A raised observer can see past the short veil. Wait past the lunge or take a different door.

heroes.aim_and_follow: Throw across a known approach, sidestep the return line, then spend a support opportunity at one local pocket.
heroes.counter: Hard cover ends travel. The start anchor is public and only the first actual pass to touch a target can pay out.

heroes.aim_and_follow: Set a protective ring on valid floor, hold the side not covered by the planter, then support a single approach.
heroes.counter: The disclosed circle lasts three seconds. The opposite lip and high-angle observer can challenge its edge.

heroes.aim_and_follow: Commit the Sun Lance glint to one grounded exit, release, then yield the angle for a new rotation.
heroes.counter: Sidestep after the glint, let hard geometry intercept it or attack during recovery.

heroes.aim_and_follow: Select smoke openly and place on one exit, move to the second exit during the tell.
heroes.counter: The marked base and real objective audio identify the screen. A clear elevated sightline can look over it.

heroes.aim_and_follow: Place a bilateral wall outside the site apron, then take the other line while both teams read its visible ends.
heroes.counter: Go around a marked end or above a confirmed line. Reject any cast that would close the only open egress.

heroes.aim_and_follow: Point at supported ground, show the impact ring, commit the visible jump and turn to protect the escort.
heroes.counter: Pressure the .45 s start or leave the marked endpoint. Body, aim and channel rules match every other hero.

heroes.aim_and_follow: Connect the first pulse to an ally behind a pocket, follow their exposed crossing only inside the sight and height bands.
heroes.counter: Break the line between caster and patient or exceed the 2.4 m height difference to sever the second pulse.

heroes.aim_and_follow: Use Measured Step to offset the bow while holding aim, draw on the fresh sightline and reserve Guardian Circle for a grounded hold.
heroes.counter: The release is a travelled projectile. A wall can shorten his step, stop his shot and deny his arrow refund.

heroes.aim_and_follow: Set a visible Stillwater Coil at a measured ramp exit; let the opponent choose a retreat before the next beat.
heroes.counter: Ground effect has a low vertical band. Leave the circle, go high, or take the other entrance.
